title: acs state fragment for /acs:run-e2e-tests
description: What THIS skill records: the `states` keys it owns and, when it completes in more than one way, its closed `outcome` vocabulary. The envelope is validated centrally by step-state.schema.json; this fragment is why adding a skill is a directory rather than an edit to a central schema (§4.4).

outcome.description: passed: every suite in the run set ran and passed. no_harness: the repo configures no suite at all -- settings.suites resolves to {} (no settings.e2e and no suites entry), so there is nothing to invoke. nothing_to_run: suites are configured, but this run has none to run -- the plan's ## Contract declares owes.e2e: false (the pre-hook records this without spawning the coordinator), or the run set resolved empty. A run where any suite failed finishes status failed with no outcome.
